release_notes: Editor tooling & worldwide GEO coverage. The landing code editor gains a VS Code-style Find & Replace (Ctrl/Cmd+F / Ctrl/Cmd+H): case, whole-word and regex modifiers, a live N-of-M match counter, Enter/Shift+Enter navigation that scrolls to each match (minified one-liners included), single Replace and count-verified Replace All, with the query pre-seeded from the editor selection. CRM and LeadForge switch to full-width layouts matching the dashboard — the 1280px cap and its side voids are gone — and no longer render the duplicated page title above their hero headers. The CRM refines its KPI row (Approval Rate under Approved Sales, a rose-tinted Shave Suspects card reporting only lost-in-transit) and adds hover copy buttons for SubID and phone in the leads table. LeadForge's GEO coverage grows from 13 to 79 countries grouped by Europe / Americas / Asia / MENA & Africa, backed by matching mobile phone masks in the build engine (order.php generation, adapter validation, Auto QA scoring). Fix: an API key arriving on a browser request that also carries a panel session is honored only when both belong to the same user (403 otherwise), and the live session is never re-identified as api_key.
